title: 196 BC
sub: In 196 BC, Sima Qian says, a Han envoy found Zhao Tuo, king of Nanyue, with his hair in a southern bun, sprawling with his legs stretched out.
say: In 196 BC, Suh-mah Chyen says, a Han envoy found Jow Twaw, king of Nahn-yweh, with his hair in a southern bun, sprawling with his legs stretched out.

title: LU JIA
sub: The envoy, Lu Jia, scolded him. You are a man of the Central States, he said.
say: The envoy, Loo Jyah, scolded him. You are a man of the Central States, he said.

title: ZHAO TUO
sub: Zhao Tuo sat up. I have lived among the southern peoples so long, he said, that I have forgotten my manners.
say: Jow Twaw sat up. I have lived among the southern peoples so long, he said, that I have forgotten my manners.

title: I AM KING HERE
sub: Then he laughed. I did not rise up in China, he said, so I am king here. Had I been there, why would I be any less than the Han?
say: Then he laughed. I did not rise up in China, he said, so I am king here. Had I been there, why would I be any less than the Han?

title: A HAN SEAL
sub: Lu Jia gave him a Han seal as King of Nanyue.
say: Loo Jyah gave him a Han seal as King of Nahn-yweh.

title: LOYAL?
sub: Did he stay a loyal vassal of Han?
say: Did he stay a loyal vassal of Han?
